text:
Maria C: Pushed a tiny webcomponents sample to the samplekit repo. Running into an auth rotation issue in the SSR demo — tokens don't refresh on edge render, so we get 401s on cold starts.
Kevin L: ugh. which SDK are you using in the browser/server bundle?
Maria C: using @redwoodai/sdk-js (the edge build). It looks fine in the client path but SSR route uses the same import and then fails when the token expires during prerender.
Ash R: can you paste the snippet where you init the client? curious about how the credential provider is wired.
Maria C: sure:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk-js/edge';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
// used in getServerSideProps -> client.chat.generate(...)
```
Samir P: ah — env var on the edge runtime won't rotate per-request. We recommend using the token provider shim for server contexts.
Maria C: tried token provider shim from examples, still saw 401s. Errors look like `401: invalid token` then a lone retry but it doesn't refresh.
Luca: can you share logs from the edge worker? the retry behavior should trigger a token refresh if the SDK sees 401 + has a provider callback.
Maria C: logs: `edge-runtime: request to /v1/chat failed 401, retrying once with fresh token` then immediately `edge-runtime: retry failed 401`. No call traced to the provider function.
Kevin L: that suggests the SDK's server-side retry path is skipping the provider refresh when running in the edge bundle. Might be a bundling/conditional import bug where the provider is a noop.
Ash R: to repro quickly for us: can you make a tiny repro with an explicit provider function that logs when invoked? if provider never logs, it's a runtime dead path.
Maria C: will do. Also saw different behavior in node server vs edge: node refreshes fine, edge doesn't.
Samir P: parity gap between node and edge SDKs — thanks for flagging. We probably need an opt-in for provider in the edge bundle or patch conditional require.
Devex Bot: Created issue #DEVEX-714 (sdk-edge-token-rotation). Assigned to eng-runtime.
Luca: quick workaround — add an explicit client-level refresh call inside your SSR handler before calling chat.generate: `await client.refreshToken?.()` then proceed. ugly but should buy time.
Maria C: works as a stopgap, thanks. I'll add a minimal repro and attach to the issue.
QA Bot: QA note: add an e2e test for SSR edge token expiry scenario and assert provider invoked on 401.
Kevin L: re: onboarding friction — could we add a short note in the samplekit README about using the provider vs env var on edge? saves folks banging heads.
Maria C: agreed, I'll open a docs PR after the repro.
Ash R: engineers: can someone from eng-runtime triage the issue? the platform's fallback should be consistent across runtimes.
Samir P: pinging @kevin-l and @eng-runtime. Also we should check SDK packaging (exports field) for the edge entrypoint.
Maria C: thanks all — will post repro link in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
